# Pacific Floors and Coatings

> Epoxy flooring contractor in Surrey, BC. We install garage, basement, commercial and industrial epoxy floors, plus polyaspartic and polyurethane coatings, across Surrey and Metro Vancouver.

- Address: 7304 138 Street, Surrey, BC V3W 5H2, Canada
- Phone: (236) 878-3386
- Email: pacificfloorsandcoatings@gmail.com
- Hours: Daily, 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM
- Service area: Surrey, Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, Langley, Delta, White Rock, New Westminster, Maple Ridge, Abbotsford
- Every install includes dust-extracted diamond grinding, slab repair, a clear top coat and a free on-site estimate.
